children.description: Parapontixanthobacter aurantiacus is a Gram-negative and aerobic bacterium from the genus Parapontixanthobacter which has been isolated from deep-sea sediments from the Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Caenibius tardaugens
children.description: Caenibius tardaugens is an oestradiol-degrading bacterium from the family Hyphomicrobiaceae which has been isolated from activated sludge from a sewage treatment plant in Japan.

children.name: Paraurantiacibacter namhicola
children.description: Paraurantiacibacter namhicola is a Gram-negative, aerobic and non-motile bacterium from the genus Paraurantiacibacter which has been isolated from seawater from the South Sea in Korea.
